GitHub - BenMcLean/Voxel2Pixel: Graphics library for rendering voxel ...
Voxel2Pixel is an MIT-licensed C# 13.0 .NET Standard 2.0 library created by Ben McLean for rendering voxel models as pixel art assets from a variety of fixed camera perspectives and palette limitations intended for use in retro-styled video games. Also in this repo is the BenVoxel project to develop an open standard for interoperable voxel model file formats.
